conventions.axes: Y-up, right-handed; camera looks down -Z by default; ground is the XZ plane at y = 0
conventions.lightIntensity: three.js physical units (directional/hemisphere/ambient: lux-like; spot/point: candela, decay 2)
conventions.easing: named functions from kit/time.js `ease` (formulas in references/kit-api.md)
conventions.camera: fov is vertical field of view in degrees (three.js convention); sensor-agnostic

style.name: Impasto
style.description: Thick oil paint in the post-impressionist manner: on a primed woven canvas, short fat brushstrokes with real 3D relief (bristle grooves along the stroke, raised edge ridges, a blob where the brush lifted, two colours dragged together) are laid one after another along a seeded swirling flow field — halo rings around a glowing moon and stars, a big double swirl in the sky, contour strokes on rolling hills, flame strokes up a cypress, dabs for a village — in ultramarine, cobalt, chrome yellow, viridian and orange. A raking light sweeps across so the paint ridges cast tiny shadows and catch glossy highlights; the camera can drop low and close so the canvas reads as a landscape of paint. Then the swirls flow: every stroke slides along its own precomputed streamline as a pure function of t. One InstancedMesh (~1,100 strokes), each instance bent into a constant-curvature arc in the vertex shader, with per-pixel bristle normals in the fragment shader; a planner schedules the stroke order and the brush sounds from the same list.
motion: A stroke grows from its start point along its own arc (progress = outCubic over its duration); the lift blob rides at the brush end.

Stroke order and timing come from strokes.js: moon and stars first, then the sky spiralling out from the big swirl, then hills, village, fields and the cypress last; each beat accelerates into a time-lapse.
The raking key light's elevation and azimuth are keyed on t; low elevation makes every ridge cast a shadow.
Flow: after flow.t0 each stroke slides along its precomputed streamline by v * G(t) — halo rings rotate, the swirl turns; nothing is integrated per frame.

notes.mechanism: strokes.js: seeded jittered grid + moon/star rings; each stroke = the region field's streamline through its seed point (RK2), bent as a constant-curvature arc; schedule per region group (lead strokes slow, rest accelerating); flow = slide along the stroke's own streamline by v*G(t).
